tools.name: find_traders
tools.description: Polymarket traders, filtered and sorted like the page; head lines say what applied and what the defaults hid. copyable: % of checked trades a follower could fill (n=checked); ret_lo: ROIC, profit per copy as % of stake, 80% low end (n=kept_n); crowd: % copied within 2 s, upper bound (n=crowd_n). <=4

tools.name: get_trader
tools.description: One trader: a row per category, rule check, radar with n, stars history, 5 newest trades. <=2 KB.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Rows per category at each stars level, plus the page's chip counts. <=800 B.

tools.name: explain_rating
tools.description: The 1-5★ rule; with trader, that trader's check per level, radar and stars history. <=1.5 KB.

tools.name: get_copy_recipe
tools.description: One trader's copy recipe for your own agent (/traders/<slug>/copy.md): watch, rules, costs, YAML. Not advice. <=5 KB.

tools.name: get_bot_guide
tools.description: How to build a copy bot and steer it with find_traders' filters (/bots.md). Not advice.
